revisions: 2: after fit pass 1-2 the fit set had no hot steady case (the held-out case step_29_to_40C then missed on sweat). Added the fit case nude_40C_rest with a target derived from the heat balance, not from model output. The held-out case step_29_to_40C is therefore SEEN for sweat and says so. Nothing else changed; two scenario inputs (dehydration 35 C, immersion film 25 x 8.3) were corrected earlier, after the baseline run and before any fit.

3 (fix after verify): the fit was redone with HC_FLESH = RAD_VIEW = 1.0 (ISO, not fitted; the first fit had let them fall to 0.41 and 0.40, which hid a wrong heat balance). Scenario definitions added, none of them chosen from a result: SEATED_EXPOSED (8 percent of the skin on the chair, for the chamber rest cases), LYING_EXPOSED (Henssge's body lies on a floor, for the corpse kind), immersion unchanged. Structure added: shell blood flow follows the vessel reflex (SHELL_VASO = 1, not fitted), work hyperemia is capped on the unscaled basal flow, Gagge sweat run-off (RUNOFF_K = 0.5, not fitted), and the compact model now shares shiver, gait, act and TEF heat between shell and core by capacity like the voxel law (it had put it all in the shell). The fit uses a linear cost, the skin diffusion is bounded by the physical TEWL (DRY 0.4-1.0 of 0.04), controller scales by 0.2-6. Targets and inputs are untouched (the sha guard still passes); nothing was fitted on a held_out case.

fit.cost_at_end: 0.4644 (linear cost: the sum over the fit cases of the distance outside each band in units of the band width, 4 percent margin; the single band that cannot close is nude_22C_rest heat production, 0.27 of it)

nude_22C_rest.cause: heat production 155 W against a band that ends at 140 W (1.57 MET). The exported rest constant (1.22 W/kg x 73 kg = 89 W, 47 W/m2) is below the 58 W/m2 of the ISO tables this band follows, so the body shivers 66 W to hold its core in a 22 C room (core 36.43 K and mean skin 30.59 K are inside their bands). At the ISO transfer coefficients the passive loss there is about 130 W plus 25 W of insensible loss. Not closed by fitting: the controller scales sit inside 0.25-2.9 of the thermoreg.py draw ranges and the skin diffusion is at its physical floor (4 g/m2/h). JOS-3 CHECK (lane J, 2026-10-30, seated nude 22 C RH 50, 24 h): JOS-3 makes 141 W at the same rest power (89 W), which is the band edge, against our 150 W in the same protocol (6 h, hour-of-day term off: +6 percent, inside the 15 percent tolerance) and 155 W in this fixture (3 h, term on); 133 W at PAR 1.00; 157 W at JOS-3's own rest (PAR 1.25, 106 W). We shiver 61 W, JOS-3 43 W plus 9 W non-shivering. Option (a) of decision N2 tried in a scratch copy: 153 W (protocol) and 159 W (fixture), so the rest constant alone does not close this; the total here is set by the heat lost and by the shiver gain.

step_29_to_40C.cause: sweat 0.179 L/h at 60 min against >=0.2. The steady 40 C case (nude_40C_rest) is inside (0.213 L/h); at 60 min the sweat controller (dead time, lag, and a core error that has risen only 0.45 K) has not reached its steady value. Mean skin (36.21 K) and the core rise (0.45 K) are inside. JOS-3 CHECK (lane J, 2026-10-30): from a 24 h start at 29 C JOS-3 sweats 0.164 L/h at minute 60 at the same rest power (0.154 at PAR 1.00, 0.202 at its own rest PAR 1.25). Ours from a 6 h start makes 0.227 L/h with the hour-of-day term off and 0.213 with it on (clock 18-19 h); this fixture (120 min start, term on, clock 14-15 h) makes 0.179. So the miss is the clock of the fixture, not a slow controller: at the same rest power ours is 30 to 40 percent ABOVE JOS-3, and the band floor 0.2 (u) is passed whenever the set point is not at its afternoon peak.

immersion_10C_lean_vs_fat.cause: lean core drop 3.71 K in 30 min of 10 C water against <=3.5 (the fat subject drops 2.35 K and the ratio 0.63 is inside). It was 4.6 K before the shiver and gait heat was shared between shell and core by capacity (as the voxel law does) and before the shell blood flow followed the vessel reflex. Still missing: tissue insulation rises on cold vasoconstriction by more than the reflex floor of the shell flow gives (Burton and Edholm 1955: 0.15 to 0.8 clo, u).

corpse_20C.cause: T_12h 28.58 K (band 28.9-31.9) and T_18h 25.75 K (band 25.9-28.9): the corpse cools 0.3 K and 0.15 K too fast late; T_1h and T_6h are inside. The lying-posture shares (scenes_bodyheat.LYING_EXPOSED, u) were written once before this fit and were not tuned to the curve.
